patterns: PYQs ask single-fact 'which race/tribe' items: Santhal = Proto-Australoid, NE hill tribes = Mongoloid, China/Japan/Mongolia and Native Americans = Mongoloid.
Distractors are other race names (Austric, Caucasoid, Dinaric, Mediterranean, Nordic); the trap is mixing linguistic (Austric, Dravidian) with racial labels.
No PYQ tests Risley vs Guha scheme details, cephalic/nasal index thresholds or AnSI facts; the app goes much deeper (index values, sub-types, ICERD).
App relies heavily on multi-statement and match-list formats while PYQs here are plain 4-option direct questions.
